Mumbai Rains Lead to Multiple Fatalities and Infrastructure Issues

Heavy monsoon rains in Mumbai have resulted in several deaths due to falling trees, manhole incidents, electrocution, and building collapses. Authorities have issued alerts and announced ex-gratia payments for victims' families. The erratic rainfall has also impacted flight operations.
